hypothesis: Different input patterns benefit from 2 continuous-affinity predictors combined by a learned gate.
decision: Select a larger repair test only if the MoE passes all frozen rules.
endpoint: log10(IC50 in micromolar units). Lower values mean stronger potency.
count_definition: Count each ensemble-member fit separately. Count each full member forward before execution. Count failed attempts.
splits: Use records.csv and splits.csv. Keep source chemical groups together. Use 5 outer and 2 inner folds.
features: Use each member final continuous predictor input. Do not use upstream feature means.

architecture.ordinary: Deep-copy the exact checkpoint final continuous MLP. Train all its parameters.
architecture.moe: 2 experts: Linear(d,32), ReLU, Linear(32,16), ReLU, Linear(16,1). Gate: Linear(d,8), ReLU, Linear(8,2), Softmax.
architecture.matched: Linear(d,w), ReLU, Linear(w,w), ReLU, Linear(w,1). Select integer w with nearest MoE parameter count. Require relative difference <=0.05.
architecture.moe_output: Sum gate probability times expert output over 2 experts.
architecture.initialization: Use native weights for ordinary. Use independent PyTorch default initialization for experts and matched. Initialize gate output weight and bias to 0. Use distinct member seeds.
architecture.gate_input: Only the same member final predictor input. Exclude labels, source IDs, group IDs, and fold IDs.

preprocessing: Use identity input preprocessing for every neural model. Use unscaled labels. This preserves ordinary checkpoint inputs.

optimization.loss: Mean squared error in native endpoint units

tuning: Use seed 1729. Select the lowest inner pooled ensemble MAE. Break ties with config 0. Give all neural models 2 configurations and 2 inner folds.
member_training: Train each member on its own inputs and the same labels. Keep the native ensemble mean.
molecular_weight: Keep the saved native flag false. The adapter retains the correction formula if the flag is true. Do not enable correction.

fingerprint.centering: Subtract only the training label mean. Add that mean to predictions.
fingerprint.seed_rule: The predictor is deterministic. Repeat the same out-of-fold predictions for seed comparisons without extra fits.

permutation_control.rule: Permute labels only inside each current training partition. Keep validation and test labels unchanged. Tune and refit the full MoE pipeline.
permutation_control.acceptance: For every seed, true-label MoE rho minus permuted-pipeline rho must be >=0.05. The paired 95% interval lower bound must exceed 0. True-label MAE minus permuted MAE must have interval upper bound <0.

uncertainty.method: 10000 paired bootstrap draws of whole chemical groups with replacement. Use percentile 2.5 and 97.5.
uncertainty.constant_draws: Retain MAE and RMSE. Omit undefined Spearman values. Report omitted draws.
uncertainty.limit: Fixed-prediction intervals omit model-refit uncertainty and measurement uncertainty.

acceptance.per_seed_and_mean: For each of 3 seeds and their metric means, compare MoE with ordinary and matched.
acceptance.missing_or_failed_fit: Defer if any required final prediction or scheduled fit remains missing.
acceptance.otherwise: Reject after complete valid evaluation. Defer after execution or agreement failure.

parity.required: Verify all 130 unchanged member scores, all 65 ensemble scores, all binary logits, and cached final predictor scores before any fitting.
parity.stop: Stop dependent work after any mismatch. Do not change tolerances or regenerate structures.

freeze_scope: Freeze structure, earlier affinity layers, pooling, shared affinity_out_mlp, and all binary layers.
retries: Retry OSError or MemoryError only after recording a concrete remedy. Keep attempt logs. Other failures stop. Respect time and call limits.
boundaries: Expert usage does not establish meaningful specialization.
Expert assignments do not establish physical mechanisms.
A failed MoE test does not prove absent useful information.
This study tests the final predictor only.
Broader claims require independent evaluation and ordinary affinity-module fine-tuning.
Training-pair overlap and blank source qualifiers remain unresolved.
